Our legal and InfoSec teams reviewed the security exhibit and came back with a few open items before procurement can approve: 1) clarification on pen-test timing/notice and whether you accept a bounded inspection approach (we prefer phased access with sampled evidence rather than full on-demand inspections), 2) SOC 2 report retention and whether you will provide attestation for the prior 12 months, and 3) an evidence cadence for operational artifacts (weekly snapshots vs ad-hoc access).

- The pen-test notice window you can commit to (our default ask is 30 days)

Hi Sophie —

Appreciate the clear list. High-level answers below; happy to expand on a call.

- Pen-test notice: We can commit to a 30-day notice for scheduled external penetration tests tied to the Order Form. For emergency/forensic work (root cause of incidents) we follow the exception path in the exhibit.

- Inspection phasing: Redwood supports bounded, phased inspections. Proposed approach:
  * Phase 1 (onboard): full evidence-onboarding window (up to 2 weeks) to validate SOC 2 assertions and run initial scans.
  * Phase 2 (recurring): sampled evidence snapshots on a weekly cadence for the first 90 days post-onboard, then monthly thereafter unless a trigger is hit.
  * For pen-tests we will agree a scoped statement of work and target environments; we will not provide unrestricted live access to production — staging or time-boxed inspection windows are preferred.

- Evidence owners / staffing: I propose Kimberly Park (cc’d) as the primary evidence owner for onboarding; Ben Carter will be the ops lead for pen-test coordination and staging. Legal redline responsibilities would be with Laura Bennett for MSA language.

I attached a draft with suggested redlines and a short evidence runbook template to make the cadence concrete.

Attached: redlines-msa-orderform-draft.docx, evidence-runbook-template.pdf

If that aligns I can assemble a concise MSA snippet for Laura to review and we’ll schedule a 30-minute scoping call with your InfoSec.

Lukas —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and for looping in your team. HealthCore can accept the phased inspection model with the following small clarifications before legal signs off:
- SOC 2: we need a 12-month rolling SOC 2 attestation (Type II) on file; if you cannot provide the full report we will accept a letter of attestation + SOC 2 bridging statements for the last 12 months.
- Evidence retention: the weekly snapshots (first 90 days) are fine; please confirm retention of any shared artifacts for 90 days after delivery.
- Pen-test SOW: we will provide a scoped SOW for each pen-test and expect a remediation timeline based on severity (30 days high, 90 days medium, 180 days low) with an option for revalidation testing.

We reviewed the runbook and redline draft you attached. If Laura can send a short exhibit snippet by EOD Friday we’ll route to our legal and procurement. After that we can finalize via DocuSign — I included a placeholder link below (we’ll send our official one once legal confirms).
